examples.en: He tapped his feet, hummed tunes and jiggled around.
examples.zh: 他拍着脚，哼着曲子并抖动着。

examples.en: You can use this software to burn custom compilations of your favourite tunes.
examples.zh: 你可以用这个软件刻制你最喜欢曲子的自选曲集。

examples.en: We listen to children's shows on the radio, and Janey can sing along with all the tunes.
examples.zh: 我们听着收音机上的儿童演出节目，珍妮能跟着所有的曲子一起哼唱。
